Inside

What you find here

From the menu and from what guests write in their Google reviews.

Cyprus coffee

Cyprus coffee, frappe and freddo from the morning on. Guests write that the Cyprus coffee is worth the short wait.

Ouzo and zivania

Ouzo, zivania and tsipouro by the glass, cold beer, wine and cocktails.

Something to go with it

Small or big meze with tomato, cucumber, halloumi and olives. Several guests write that snacks came to the table from the house.

Antiques

The walls are full of instruments, old keys, plates and pictures, and a handwritten sign says that old coins and banknotes are bought and sold.

Inside

Photos from the Google listing of To Perasma.

How guests describe a visit

Taken from what guests write in their Google reviews.

A friendly host

43 of the reviews mention the owner, almost always for how welcome he makes guests feel.

Courtyard at the back

Tables on the pedestrian street in front, and a sheltered courtyard at the back with a view of the minaret.

Greek music

Guests write about bouzouki and old Greek songs, backgammon and time to watch the street.

An old shop with blue shutters

To Perasma sits in an old stone shop on Kleanthi Kalogera, near Zouhouri Square, with blue wooden shutters hung with guitars. Inside it is part cafe, part bar and part antique shop, and guests describe it as a place that reminds them of old Cyprus.

What guests say

Three of 130 Google reviews, all three with five stars.

“Unique cafe/bar in the heart of historic old town Larnaka. This place really does not get the attention it deserves. Excellent service and great atmosphere. Owner is very welcoming and friendly, you will experience true Cypriot hospitality. This place is truly a gem!”

Google review
“A beautiful cozy local shop in the heart of Larnaka. Give you the chance to get some unique antiques if you are a lover. The classic style Reminds you the old days of Cyprus. Owend by a very friendly and kind family. A must go destination”

Google review
„Originelles Café mit großer Getränkeauswahl in bester Lage. Der Besitzer ist immer für einen Spaß zu haben und man kann ganz wundervoll Leute beobachten. Eines meiner Lieblingscafes in ganz Larnaka!“
